# Describing data {#sec-describing-data}

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Code in this chapter uses **R**.
:::

The sample mean of observations $x_1, \dots, x_n$ is
$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i .
$$ {#eq-mean}

```{r}
#| label: summary-faithful
data(faithful)
summary(faithful$eruptions)
mean(faithful$eruptions)
sd(faithful$eruptions)
```

@fig-faithful-hist shows that eruption durations are bimodal, so the mean
in @eq-mean is not a "typical" value here.

```{r}
#| label: fig-faithful-hist
#| fig-cap: "Old Faithful eruption durations (minutes)."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.5
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(faithful, aes(x = eruptions)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
  labs(x = "Eruption duration (min)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

To practice computing these summaries yourself, see
@sec-practice-describing.
